title: Genesis 8:8-9 — the first dove: hovers, but no rest
summary: Genesis 8:8-9 quoted in English with Hebrew reference: Noah sends out a dove, it finds nowhere to perch and returns to him in the ark. The slide concludes "1st DOVE: Hovers, but No Rest". The words dove, Noah and ark are highlighted.

text.text: 8 Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.

9 But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.
